world.title: More than 1,300 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France
world.description: Hundreds of thousands took part in demonstrations in France, with protests also taking place in other European countries.

world.title: Israel to close West Bank crossings on election day as crackdown escalates
world.description: The Israeli Defense Forces announces restrictions on the movement of Palestinian workers in the run-up to Tuesday's election.

world.title: Voters in Brazil head to polls as Lula goes up against Bolsonaro's son
world.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the son of Brazil's imprisoned ex-president, is challenging Lula, who is seeking a fourth term in office.

world.title: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink connection as service restored
world.description: The tech billionaire accuses Ukraine of violating its terms of service by using the network for military activity.

world.title: Gunmen kill at least 10 villagers and loot shops in north-east Nigeria
world.description: Police are searching for other casualties, with officials warning the actual death toll could rise further.

world.title: Man arrested after fire at Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat
world.description: Some 200 emergency personnel were deployed to fight the blaze at the Nazi dictator's Alpine residence in Germany.

world.title: Vanessa Trump says she is cancer-free six months after revealing diagnosis
world.description: The ex-wife of Donald Trump Jr, with whom she shares five children, announced in May that she had been diagnosed with breast cancer.

world.title: El Salvador president says bodies found in Haiti are not those of hostages
world.description: Nayib Bukele says bodies delivered to soldiers are "not our men" amid search for Salvadorans abducted last week.

world.title: Obama attacks Trump as he campaigns for Democrats ahead of midterm elections
world.description: Obama said the election was "the last best chance to at least rein in some of the foolishness of this administration".

world.title: Mum who died trying to save sons was hero, husband says
world.description: Nathan Gregory says the loss of childhood sweetheart Leanne "is unimaginable for our family".

world.title: Woman, 65, becomes second patient to die of Ebola in Kenya
world.description: She was a close family member of the first victim, a man who had travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo.

world.title: Australian MP's condition improves after alleged car attack
world.description: The independent MP is now in a serious but stable condition, according to the Melbourne hospital.

world.title: From Russian cages to Irish sanctuary: The five-year rescue journey of Bu and Tyapa
world.description: For Bu and Tyapa, the five-year journey from Russia to the Irish countryside was anything but straightforward.

world.title: Three released without charge after fatal arson attack in Ireland
world.description: Three people - two women and one man - have been released, and one person remains in custody, gardaí say.

world.title: Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save
world.description: Kaylub Giamanco has been hailed as a hero for killing a teenager who fatally shot three children and a teacher.

US.title: The College of Magic turns ordinary kids into confident, top-hat wearing magicians
US.description: The students, many from marginalized communities, learn to conjure up candy, do card tricks — and face the world with a confident, creative and resilient mindset.

US.title: When a teen posts a selfie, how much filter is 'too much' filter?
US.description: The recent Meta settlement includes a clause banning "cosmetic procedure filters" for teens. But defining what constitutes an extreme makeover isn't easy.

US.title: More dads taking paid family leave for a new baby, sometimes as much as moms are
US.description: The U.S. has no national law for paid parental leave. But in states that do, more dads are using the benefit, sometimes more than moms. The change comes as Americans say having kids is unaffordable.

US.title: Independent candidates sense a moment. Some Democrats hope they're right.
US.description: As they look to win the Senate, Democrats are hoping that independent candidates in Nebraska and Montana can help them topple Republicans in a part of the country where their own brand is hurting.

US.title: In Arkansas, Democrats see an opening at the edge of the competitive midterms map
US.description: In a sign of the potentially dire midterm political environment, Republicans have spent millions of dollars playing defense in Arkansas, one of the most conservative states in the country.

US.title: Soldiers guard center of Milan as thousands of protesters march in cities across Europe
US.description: While protests in France have claimed most international attention, large demonstrations also rocked many European cities Saturday from Milan to Rome to Madrid, Lisbon and Tirana.

US.title: Drought, fire and high diesel prices 'addin' up tough' for Oregon ranchers
US.description: Record diesel prices are kicking Western ranchers while they're down. Drought means they have to buy extra hay, and pay truckers extra to deliver it because of fuel price hikes.

US.title: Archdiocese of New York agrees to $800 million settlement over sexual abuse claims
US.description: The 1,300 survivors of sexual abuse by clergy members and lay workers have all agreed to the settlement, according to an attorney for some of the plaintiffs.

US.title: Trade tariffs cause whiplash at Port Milwaukee
US.description: Sacha Pfeiffer visits Port Milwaukee to see how President Trump's tariffs have affected the flow of goods and impacted the regional economy.

US.title: How data centers became a bipartisan political issue in Wisconsin
US.description: Data centers are a big issue across the country. As midterms approach, many look to the swing state of Wisconsin for lessons for how that issue could play out nationally.
